ApipInteraction.Description: Information defining an assessment item interaction that may be specified using the IMS Global Accessible Portable Item Protocol APIP(R) standards.
ApipInteraction.Name: ApipInteraction

APIPInteractionSequenceNumber.Description: The position of this APIP Interaction in a sequence of interactions.
APIPInteractionSequenceNumber.Name: APIPInteractionSequenceNumber

AssessmentItemBodyAssociateInteractionXM.Description: An associate interaction presents candidates with a number of choices and allows them to create associations between them. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.
AssessmentItemBodyAssociateInteractionXM.Name: AssessmentItemBodyAssociateInteractionXML

AssessmentItemBodyChoiceInteractionXML.Description: The choice interaction presents a set of choices to the candidate. The candidate's task is to select one or more of the choices, up to a maximum of maxChoices. The interaction is always initialized with no choices selected. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.
AssessmentItemBodyChoiceInteractionXML.Name: AssessmentItemBodyChoiceInteractionXML

AssessmentItemBodyCustomInteractionXML.Description: The custom interaction provides an opportunity for extensibility of this specification to include support for interactions not currently documented.  The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.
AssessmentItemBodyCustomInteractionXML.Name: AssessmentItemBodyCustomInteractionXML

AssessmentItemBodyDrawingInteractionXML.Description: The drawing interaction allows the candidate to use a common set of drawing tools to modify a given graphical image (the canvas). It must be bound to a response variable with base-type file and single cardinality. The result is a file in the same format as the original image. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.
AssessmentItemBodyDrawingInteractionXML.Name: AssessmentItemBodyDrawingInteractionXML

AssessmentItemBodyEndAttemptInteractionX.Description: The end attempt interaction is a special type of interaction which allows item authors to provide the candidate with control over the way in which the candidate terminates an attempt. The candidate can use the interaction to terminate the attempt (triggering response processing) immediately, typically to request a hint. It must be bound to a response variable with base-type boolean and single cardinality. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.
AssessmentItemBodyEndAttemptInteractionX.Name: AssessmentItemBodyEndAttemptInteractionXML

AssessmentItemBodyExtendedTextInteractio.Description: An extended text interaction allows the candidate to enter an extended amount of text. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.
AssessmentItemBodyExtendedTextInteractio.Name: AssessmentItemBodyExtendedTextInteractionXML

AssessmentItemBodyGapMatchInteractionXML.Description: A gap match interaction contains a number gaps that the candidate can fill from an associated set of choices. The candidate must be able to review the content with the gaps filled in context, as indicated by their choices. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.
AssessmentItemBodyGapMatchInteractionXML.Name: AssessmentItemBodyGapMatchInteractionXML

AssessmentItemBodyGraphicGapMatchInterac.Description: A graphic gap-match interaction is a graphical interaction with a set of gaps that are defined as areas (hotspots) of the graphic image and an additional set of gap choices that are defined outside the image. The candidate must associate the gap choices with the gaps in the image and be able to review the image with the gaps filled in context, as indicated by their choices. Care should be taken when designing these interactions to ensure that the gaps in the image are a suitable size to receive the required gap choices. It must be clear to the candidate which hotspot each choice has been associated with. When associated, choices must appear wholly inside the gaps if at all possible and, where overlaps are required, should not hide each other completely. If the candidate indicates the association by positioning the choice over the gap (e.g., drag and drop) the system should 'snap' it to the nearest position that satisfies these requirements. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.
AssessmentItemBodyGraphicGapMatchInterac.Name: AssessmentItemBodyGraphicGapMatchInteractionXML

AssessmentItemBodyGraphicOrderInteractio.Description: A graphic order interaction is a graphic interaction with a corresponding set of choices that are defined as areas of the graphic image. The candidate's task is to impose an ordering on the areas (hotspots). The order hotspot interaction should only be used when the spatial relationship of the choices with respect to each other (as represented by the graphic image) is important to the needs of the item. Otherwise, orderInteraction should be used instead with separate material for each option. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.
AssessmentItemBodyGraphicOrderInteractio.Name: AssessmentItemBodyGraphicOrderInteractionXML

AssessmentItemBodyHotSpotInteractionXML.Description: A hotspot interaction is a graphical interaction with a corresponding set of choices that are defined as areas of the graphic image. The candidate's task is to select one or more of the areas (hotspots). The hotspot interaction should only be used when the spatial relationship of the choices with respect to each other (as represented by the graphic image) is important to the needs of the item. Otherwise, choiceInteraction should be used instead with separate material for each option. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.
AssessmentItemBodyHotSpotInteractionXML.Name: AssessmentItemBodyHotSpotInteractionXML

AssessmentItemBodyHottextInteractionXML.Description: The hottext interaction presents a set of choices to the candidate represented as selectable runs of text embedded within a surrounding context, such as a simple passage of text. Like choiceInteraction, the candidate's task is to select one or more of the choices, up to a maximum of maxChoices. The interaction is initialized from the defaultValue of the associated response variable, a NULL value indicating that no choices are selected (the usual case). The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.
AssessmentItemBodyHottextInteractionXML.Name: AssessmentItemBodyHottextInteractionXML

AssessmentItemBodyInlineChoiceInteractio.Description: A inline choice is an inline interaction that presents the user with a set of choices, each of which is a simple piece of text. The candidate's task is to select one of the choices. Unlike the Choice Interaction, the delivery engine must allow the candidate to review their choice within the context of the surrounding text.
AssessmentItemBodyInlineChoiceInteractio.Name: AssessmentItemBodyInlineChoiceInteractionXML

AssessmentItemBodyMatchInteractionXML.Description: A match interaction presents candidates with two sets of choices and allows them to create associates between pairs of choices in the two sets, but not between pairs of choices in the same set. Further restrictions can still be placed on the allowable associations using the matchMax attribute of the choices. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.
AssessmentItemBodyMatchInteractionXML.Name: AssessmentItemBodyMatchInteractionXML

AssessmentItemBodyMediaInteractionXML.Description: The media interaction allows more control over the way the candidate interacts with a time-based media object and allows the number of times the media object was experienced to be reported in the value of the associated response variable, which must be of base-type integer and single cardinality. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.
AssessmentItemBodyMediaInteractionXML.Name: AssessmentItemBodyMediaInteractionXML

AssessmentItemBodyOrderInteractionXML.Description: In an order interaction the candidate's task is to reorder the choices, the order in which the choices are displayed initially is significant. By default the candidate's task is to order all of the choices but a subset of the choices can be requested using the maxChoices and minChoices attributes. When specified the candidate must select a subset of the choices and impose an ordering on them. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.
AssessmentItemBodyOrderInteractionXML.Name: AssessmentItemBodyOrderInteractionXML

AssessmentItemBodyPositionObjectInteract.Description: The position object interaction consists of a single image which must be positioned on another graphic image (the stage) by the candidate. Like selectPointInteraction, the associated response may have an areaMapping that scores the response on the basis of comparing it against predefined areas but the delivery engine must not indicate these areas of the stage. Only the actual position(s) selected by the candidate shall be indicated. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.
AssessmentItemBodyPositionObjectInteract.Name: AssessmentItemBodyPositionObjectInteractionXML

AssessmentItemBodySelectPointInteraction.Description: A graphic associate interaction is a graphic interaction with a corresponding set of choices that are defined as areas of the graphic image. The candidate's task is to associate the areas (hotspots) with each other. The graphic associate interaction should only be used when the graphical relationship of the choices with respect to each other (as represented by the graphic image) is important to the needs of the item. Otherwise, associateInteraction should be used instead with separate Material for each option. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.
AssessmentItemBodySelectPointInteraction.Name: AssessmentItemBodySelectPointInteraction

AssessmentItemBodySelectPointInteraction.Description: Like hotspotInteraction, a select point interaction is a graphic interaction. The candidate's task is to select one or more points. The associated response may have an areaMapping that scores the response on the basis of comparing it against predefined areas but the delivery engine must not indicate these areas of the image. Only the actual point(s) selected by the candidate shall be indicated. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.
AssessmentItemBodySelectPointInteraction.Name: AssessmentItemBodySelectPointInteractionXML

AssessmentItemBodySliderInteractionXML.Description: The slider interaction presents the candidate with a control for selecting a numerical value between a lower and upper bound. It must be bound to a response variable with single cardinality with a base-type of either integer or float. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.
AssessmentItemBodySliderInteractionXML.Name: AssessmentItemBodySliderInteractionXML

AssessmentItemBodyTextEntryInteractionXM.Description: A textEntry interaction obtains a simple piece of text from the candidate. Like inlineChoiceInteraction, the delivery engine must allow the candidate to review their choice within the context of the surrounding text. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.
AssessmentItemBodyTextEntryInteractionXM.Name: AssessmentItemBodyTextEntryInteractionXML

AssessmentItemBodyUploadInteractionXML.Description: The upload interaction allows the candidate to upload a pre-prepared file representing their response. It must be bound to a response variable with base-type file and single cardinality. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.
AssessmentItemBodyUploadInteractionXML.Name: AssessmentItemBodyUploadInteractionXML

AssessmentItemAPIPItemBodyXML.Description: The item body contains the text, graphics, media objects, and interactions that describe the item's content and information about how it is structured. The body is presented by combining it with stylesheet information, either explicitly or implicitly using the default style rules of the delivery or authoring system. This element contains the appropriate XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification defining the various item body interactions.
AssessmentItemAPIPItemBodyXML.Name: AssessmentItemAPIPItemBodyXML

AssessmentItemAPIPModalFeedbackXML.Description: Modal feedback is shown to the candidate directly following response processing. The value of an outcome variable is used in conjunction with the showHide and identifier attributes to determine whether or not the feedback is shown in a similar way to feedbackElement. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.
AssessmentItemAPIPModalFeedbackXML.Name: AssessmentItemAPIPModalFeedbackXML

AssessmentItemAPIPOutcomeDeclarationXML.Description: Outcome variables are declared by outcome declarations. Their value is set either from a default given in the declaration itself or by a responseRule during response processing.  The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.
AssessmentItemAPIPOutcomeDeclarationXML.Name: AssessmentItemAPIPOutcomeDeclarationXML

AssessmentItemAPIPResponseDeclarationXML.Description: Response declarations state what the response variables include.  The response declaration may assign an optional correct response. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.
AssessmentItemAPIPResponseDeclarationXML.Name: AssessmentItemAPIPResponseDeclarationXML

AssessmentItemAPIPResponseProcessingTemp.Description: These templates are described using the processing language defined in IMS Global APIP specification and are distributed (in XML form) along with it. Delivery engines that support generalized response processing do not need to implement special mechanisms to support them as a template file can be parsed directly while processing the assessment item that refers to it. This element provides the URL for the template.
AssessmentItemAPIPResponseProcessingTemp.Name: AssessmentItemAPIPResponseProcessingTemplateURL

AssessmentItemAPIPResponseProcessingXML.Description: Response processing is the process by which the Delivery Engine assigns outcomes based on the learner's responses. The outcomes may be used to provide feedback to the learner Feedback is either provided immediately following the end of the learner's attempt or it is provided at some later time, perhaps as part of a summary report on the item session. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.
AssessmentItemAPIPResponseProcessingXML.Name: AssessmentItemAPIPResponseProcessingXML

AssessmentItemAPIPTemplateDeclarationXML.Description: Template declarations declare item variables that are to be used specifically for the purposes of cloning items. They can have their value set only during template processing. They are referred to within the item body in order to individualize the clone and possibly also within the response Processing rules if the cloning process affects the way the item is scored.  The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.
AssessmentItemAPIPTemplateDeclarationXML.Name: AssessmentItemAPIPTemplateDeclarationXML

AssessmentItemAPIPTemplateProcessingXML.Description: Template processing consists of one or more template rules that are followed by the cloning engine or delivery system in order to assign values to the template variables. Template processing is identical in form to responseProcessing except that the purpose is to assign values to template variables, not outcome variables. The XML from the IMS Global APIP Specification would be included.
AssessmentItemAPIPTemplateProcessingXML.Name: AssessmentItemAPIPTemplateProcessingXML

AssessmentItemResponseDescriptiveFeedbac.Description: The date and time the descriptive feedback was entered in response to the results from a scored/evaluated assessment item.

hasAssessmentItemResponseScaffoldingItem.Name: hasAssessmentItemResponseScaffoldingItemFlag

hasAssessmentItemResponseScoreStatus.Description: The status of scoring a person's response to an assessment item.
hasAssessmentItemResponseScoreStatus.Name: hasAssessmentItemResponseScoreStatus

hasAssessmentItemResponseStatus.Description: The status of the response for a given item.
hasAssessmentItemResponseStatus.Name: hasAssessmentItemResponseStatus

hasAssessmentItemRubricCriterionResult.Description: References information about an assessment result or score derived using a rubic criterion.
hasAssessmentItemRubricCriterionResult.Name: hasAssessmentItemRubricCriterionResult

hasLearnerAction.Description: References information about clickstream data for online assessments and other experiences such as is used by intelligent tutoring systems. The model is compatible with the structure of data found in Experience API (xAPI) specification.
hasLearnerAction.Name: hasLearnerAction

hasProficiencyStatus.Description: An indication of whether a student's scores were proficient.
hasProficiencyStatus.Name: hasProficiencyStatus

AssessmentItemResponseTheory.Description: Information representing the difficulty of an assessment itme and other measures of the relationship between any individuals' performances on the test item and the test takers' levels of performance on an overall measure of the ability that item was designed to measure.
AssessmentItemResponseTheory.Name: AssessmentItemResponseTheory

AssessmentItemResponseTheoryDIFValue.Description: A value representing the Differential Item Functioning, also referred to as  measurement bias, for the assessment item.  The value represents differences in the functioning of the item across groups which are matched on the attribute being measure by the item.  The value is calculated using Mantel-Haenszel approach or a comparable algorithm so that a value of 1.0 represents no bias.
AssessmentItemResponseTheoryDIFValue.Name: AssessmentItemResponseTheoryDIFValue

AssessmentItemResponseTheoryKappaValue.Description: The measure used to represent the degree of agreement among raters.
AssessmentItemResponseTheoryKappaValue.Name: AssessmentItemResponseTheoryKappaValue

AssessmentItemResponseTheoryParameterA.Description: The Item Response Theory value representing the discrimination of the item. The a parameter is found by taking the slope of the line tangent to the item characteristic curve at the inflection point, B. The parameter is the steepness of the curve at its steepest point.
AssessmentItemResponseTheoryParameterA.Name: AssessmentItemResponseTheoryParameterA

AssessmentItemResponseTheoryParameterB.Description: The Item Response Theory value representing the difficulty of the item.   It is the Theta value for the location of the inflection point of the item characteristic curve.
AssessmentItemResponseTheoryParameterB.Name: AssessmentItemResponseTheoryParameterB

AssessmentItemResponseTheoryParameterC.Description: The Item Response Theory value for multiple choice items representing the guessing of the item. The c parameter is a lower asymptote. It is the low point of the curve as it moves to negative infinity on the horizontal axis. You can think of c as the probability that a chicken would get the item right.
AssessmentItemResponseTheoryParameterC.Name: AssessmentItemResponseTheoryParameterC

AssessmentItemResponseTheoryParameterD1.Description: For   polytomous assessment items with more than two possible responses, this is the item response theory value representing the threshold between the first and second item characteristic functions.
AssessmentItemResponseTheoryParameterD1.Name: AssessmentItemResponseTheoryParameterD1

AssessmentItemResponseTheoryParameterD2.Description: For   polytomous assessment items with more than two possible responses, this is the item response theory value representing the threshold between the second and third item characteristic functions.
AssessmentItemResponseTheoryParameterD2.Name: AssessmentItemResponseTheoryParameterD2

AssessmentItemResponseTheoryParameterD3.Description: For   polytomous assessment items with more than three possible responses, this is the item response theory value representing the threshold between the third and fourth item characteristic functions.
AssessmentItemResponseTheoryParameterD3.Name: AssessmentItemResponseTheoryParameterD3

AssessmentItemResponseTheoryParameterD4.Description: For   polytomous assessment items with more than four possible responses, this is the item response theory value representing the threshold between the fourth and fifth item characteristic functions.
AssessmentItemResponseTheoryParameterD4.Name: AssessmentItemResponseTheoryParameterD4

AssessmentItemResponseTheoryParameterD5.Description: For   polytomous assessment items with more than five possible responses, this is the item response theory value representing the threshold between the fifth and sixth item characteristic functions.
AssessmentItemResponseTheoryParameterD5.Name: AssessmentItemResponseTheoryParameterD5

AssessmentItemResponseTheoryParameterD6.Description: For   polytomous assessment items with more than six possible responses, this is the item response theory value representing the threshold between the sixth and seventh item characteristic functions.
AssessmentItemResponseTheoryParameterD6.Name: AssessmentItemResponseTheoryParameterD6

AssessmentItemResponseTheoryPointBiseria.Description: The correlation between correct answers on this item and total correct answers on the test during a previous administration.
AssessmentItemResponseTheoryPointBiseria.Name: AssessmentItemResponseTheoryPointBiserialCorrelationValue

hasAssessmentItemResponseTheoryKappaAlgo.Description: The algorithm used to derive the Assessment Item Kappa Value
hasAssessmentItemResponseTheoryKappaAlgo.Name: hasAssessmentItemResponseTheoryKappaAlgorithm

hasAssessmentItemResponseTheoryParameter.Description: A category for the difficulty of the item based on the Item Response Theory value.

hasAssessmentNeedSigningType.Description: Defines as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile the type of signing preferred by the user.

hasAssessmentNeedSpokenSourcePreferenceT.Description: Defines as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile the preferred spoken audio form.

hasAssessmentNeedUserSpokenPreferenceTyp.Description: Used as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile to define the type of material that should be rendered using the read aloud alternative content.

AssessmentNeedApipControl.Description: Used as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile to define the control attributes.

AssessmentNeedBackgroundColor.Description: This is the preferred Background color for screen enhancement defined as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile.

AssessmentNeedLineReaderHighlightColor.Description: The color defined as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile to be used to highlight the point of line reader activity i.e. the line being read.

AssessmentNeedLineReaderHighlightColor.Notes: textFormat Color hex code; maxLength 6; minLength 6

AssessmentNeedOverlayColor.Notes: textFormat Color hex code; maxLength 6; minLength 6

AssessmentNeedTimeMultiplier.Description: Defines the multiplier to be applied to the time limit to determine the total testing time allowed when Additional Testing Time is specified as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile.  If the value is 'unlimited' then there is no time limit for the test.
AssessmentNeedTimeMultiplier.Name: AssessmentNeedTimeMultiplier

hasAssessmentAcademicSubject.Description: The description of the academic content or subject area (e.g., arts, mathematics, reading, or a foreign language) being evaluated.
hasAssessmentAcademicSubject.Name: hasAssessmentAcademicSubject

hasAssessmentContentStandardType.Description: An indication as to whether an assessment conforms to a standard.
hasAssessmentContentStandardType.Name: hasAssessmentContentStandardType

hasAssessmentForm.Description: References an instance of an assessment that can equate scores with another instance of that same assessment.
hasAssessmentForm.Name: hasAssessmentForm

hasAssessmentFormSubtestContainerOnly.Description: In a hierarchy of subtests, this indicates that this tier is only used as a level in the hierarchy and does not represent a scoring model.
hasAssessmentFormSubtestContainerOnly.Name: hasAssessmentFormSubtestContainerOnly

hasAssessmentPerformanceLevel.Description: References information about the performance levels that may be assigned to an Assessment Subtest Result and specifications for selecting the performance level based on a score. Four styles are supported: 1) specification of performance level by lower and upper cut score, 2) specification of performance level by lower cut score only, 3) specification of performance level without any mapping to scores, and 4) Specification of performance level by mapping to other scores.
hasAssessmentPerformanceLevel.Name: hasAssessmentPerformanceLevel

hasAssessmentPurpose.Description: The reason for which an assessment is designed or delivered.
hasAssessmentPurpose.Name: hasAssessmentPurpose

hasAssessmentResult.Description: References an entity that includes information about a person's results from an assessment which may be for the entire assessment or one aspect of evaluation. The scoring method is defined by the related Assessment Subtest. The entity includes the score value and information about the score, such as a diagnostic statement.
hasAssessmentResult.Name: hasAssessmentResult

hasAssessmentScoreMetricType.Description: The specific method used to report the performance and achievement of the assessment. This is the metric that is being used to derive the scores.
hasAssessmentScoreMetricType.Name: hasAssessmentScoreMetricType

hasAssessmentSubtest.Description: References information for scoring an Assessment Form based on a set of Assessment Item responses with explicit rules to produce an Assessment Subtest Result, which may be for the entire Assessment Form or one aspect of evaluation based on a subset of Assessment Items.
hasAssessmentSubtest.Name: hasAssessmentSubtest

hasAssessmentSubtestAssessmentItem.Description: References information linking assessment subtest to an assessment item.
hasAssessmentSubtestAssessmentItem.Name: hasAssessmentSubtestAssessmentItem

hasAssessmentSubtestEarlyLearningDevelop.Description: References developmental domains related to early learning and used for assessing a child's kindergarten readiness.
hasAssessmentSubtestEarlyLearningDevelop.Name: hasAssessmentSubtestEarlyLearningDevelopmentalDomain

hasAssessmentSubtestIdentifierType.Description: The type of identifier that is provided for a Subtest.
hasAssessmentSubtestIdentifierType.Name: hasAssessmentSubtestIdentifierType

hasCompetencyDefinition.Description: References a resource that states a capability or behavior that a person may learn or be able to do within a given context with references to potential levels of competence, a mastery threshold, and other contextualizing metadata.
hasCompetencyDefinition.Name: hasCompetencyDefinition

hasGradeLevel.Description: The specific grade level or combination of grade levels.
hasGradeLevel.Name: hasGradeLevel

AssessmentSubtestAssessmentItem.Description: This join links an assessment subtest to an assessment item.
AssessmentSubtestAssessmentItem.Name: AssessmentSubtestAssessmentItem

AssessmentFormSubtestItemWeightCorrect.Description: A weighting factor for how the item score is used to compute a sub-test score when the item is correct or partially correct. Item weight of 1 indicates the full item score is used. A weight of .5 would indicate the item only contributes one half of the item score to the subtest. A weight of 0 indicates the item does not affect the sub test score.
AssessmentFormSubtestItemWeightCorrect.Name: AssessmentFormSubtestItemWeightCorrect

AssessmentFormSubtestItemWeightIncorrect.Description: A weighting factor for how the item score is used to compute a sub-test score when the item is attempted and incorrect. Item weight should be a negative value if the item subtracts from the score if missed.
AssessmentFormSubtestItemWeightIncorrect.Name: AssessmentFormSubtestItemWeightIncorrect

AssessmentFormSubtestItemWeightNotAttemp.Description: A weighting factor for how the item score is used to compute a sub-test score when the item has not been attempted by the student. Item weight should be a negative value if the item subtracts from the score if not attempted.
AssessmentFormSubtestItemWeightNotAttemp.Name: AssessmentFormSubtestItemWeightNotAttempted

hasAssessmentItem.Description: References a specific prompt that defines a question or protocol for a measurable activity that triggers a response from a person used to determine whether the person has mastered a learning objective.
hasAssessmentItem.Name: hasAssessmentItem

Assignment.Description: A specific type of Membership that represents a staff person's assignment within an educational institution, characterized by properties related to their specific duties and responsibilities. This includes linking a staff person to particular assignments such as course sections, administrative roles, or other institutional tasks over a defined period of time. The concept captures elements such as the start and end dates of the assignment, the specific role or position held, and the nature of the duties performed.
Assignment.Name: Assignment

AssignmentEndDate.Description: The last year, month and day on which the assignment is valid.
AssignmentEndDate.Name: AssignmentEndDate

AssignmentStartDate.Description: The year, month and day from which the assignment is valid.
AssignmentStartDate.Name: AssignmentStartDate

StaffFullTimeEquivalency.Description: The ratio between the hours of work expected in a position and the hours of work normally expected in a full-time position in the same setting.
StaffFullTimeEquivalency.Name: StaffFullTimeEquivalency

TeachingAssignmentContributionPercentage.Description: A percentage used to weight the educator's assigned responsibility for student learning in a Class Section, particularly when more than one educator is assigned to the class section.
TeachingAssignmentContributionPercentage.Name: TeachingAssignmentContributionPercentage

TeachingAssignmentEndDate.Description: The year, month and day on which a teaching assignment ends.
TeachingAssignmentEndDate.Name: TeachingAssignmentEndDate

TeachingAssignmentStartDate.Description: The year, month and day on which a teaching assignment begins.
TeachingAssignmentStartDate.Name: TeachingAssignmentStartDate

hasClassroomPositionType.Description: The type of position the staff member holds in the specific course section.
hasClassroomPositionType.Name: hasClassroomPositionType

hasTeachingAssignmentRole.Description: The role that the Staff Member has been assigned for a Class Section. (A teacher may have the lead responsibility for one section and serve a supporting role for another section of the same course.)
hasTeachingAssignmentRole.Name: hasTeachingAssignmentRole

Authentication.Description: An application or service that can authenticate the identity of a person. The CEDS entity that includes information about an authentication provider, the login identifier used to authenticate a person's identity, and other information related to authentication of a person's identity.
Authentication.Name: Authentication

AuthenticationIdentityProviderEndDate.Description: The date after which the  an associated person is no longer allowed to use the specified Authentication Identity Provider to authenticate identity.
AuthenticationIdentityProviderEndDate.Name: AuthenticationIdentityProviderEndDate

AuthenticationIdentityProviderLoginIdent.Description: The login identifier for the person for the specified Authentication Identity Provider.
AuthenticationIdentityProviderLoginIdent.Name: AuthenticationIdentityProviderLoginIdentifier

AuthenticationIdentityProviderName.Description: The name of a provider that can authenticate the identity of an person.
AuthenticationIdentityProviderName.Name: AuthenticationIdentityProviderName

AuthenticationIdentityProviderStartDate.Description: The date on which the  an associated person may begin to use the specified Authentication Identity Provider to authenticate identity.
AuthenticationIdentityProviderStartDate.Name: AuthenticationIdentityProviderStartDate

AuthenticationIdentityProviderURI.Description: The Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) of the  Authentication Identity Provider.
AuthenticationIdentityProviderURI.Name: AuthenticationIdentityProviderURI

Authorization.Description: Information about a data system or application which an authenticated person may access.
Authorization.Name: Authorization

AuthorizationApplicationRoleName.Description: The user role for which the person is allowed.
AuthorizationApplicationRoleName.Name: AuthorizationApplicationRoleName

AuthorizationEndDate.Description: The date after which the  an associated person is no longer allowed to use the application with the specified role.
AuthorizationEndDate.Name: AuthorizationEndDate

AuthorizationStartDate.Description: The date on which the  an associated person  is authorized to start using the application with the specified role.
AuthorizationStartDate.Name: AuthorizationStartDate

AuthorizationDocument.Description: Information about a document that authorizes a deision or plan such as a document authorizing an IEP.
AuthorizationDocument.Name: AuthorizationDocument

AuthorizationDecisionExplanation.Description: Authorizer's explanation regarding the authorization decision.
AuthorizationDecisionExplanation.Name: AuthorizationDecisionExplanation

hasAuthorizationAcceptanceIndicator.Description: Indicates authorizer agreement to a document or plan, such as plan for delivery of student services, program, or improvement plan.
hasAuthorizationAcceptanceIndicator.Name: hasAuthorizationAcceptanceIndicator

hasAuthorizerType.Description: Type of person who authorized the decision or document.
hasAuthorizerType.Name: hasAuthorizerType

BoardMembership.Description: Information related to persons as board members within an organization.
BoardMembership.Name: BoardMembership

BoardMemberTermEndDate.Description: The date on which the board member's term ends.
BoardMemberTermEndDate.Name: BoardMemberTermEndDate

BoardMemberTermStartDate.Description: The date on which the board member's term begins.
BoardMemberTermStartDate.Name: BoardMemberTermStartDate

hasBoardMemberPositionType.Description: The position or role the person performs on the board.
hasBoardMemberPositionType.Name: hasBoardMemberPositionType

hasBoardMembershipType.Description: The type of membership for the board member.
hasBoardMembershipType.Name: hasBoardMembershipType

BuildingSpace.Description: Information describing and defining the uses of space within a building.
BuildingSpace.Name: BuildingSpace

FacilitySpaceDescription.Description: A description of the space, as determined by its physical layout and built-in systems and equipment.
FacilitySpaceDescription.Name: FacilitySpaceDescription

hasBuildingAdministrativeSpaceType.Description: The space designed primarily for conducting administrative and business functions.
hasBuildingAdministrativeSpaceType.Name: hasBuildingAdministrativeSpaceType

hasBuildingArtSpecialtySpaceType.Description: The space designed to support the teaching and learning of 2 dimensional or 3 dimensional visual arts.
hasBuildingArtSpecialtySpaceType.Name: hasBuildingArtSpecialtySpaceType

hasBuildingAssemblySpaceType.Description: An area designed primarily for theater productions, assemblies, and other large gatherings.
hasBuildingAssemblySpaceType.Name: hasBuildingAssemblySpaceType

hasBuildingBasicClassroomDesignType.Description: A classroom designed for instruction of a particular age group, but not a specific subject.
hasBuildingBasicClassroomDesignType.Name: hasBuildingBasicClassroomDesignType

hasBuildingCareer-TechnicalEducationSpac.Description: The classroom, laboratory, or shop specially located, designed, furnished, and equipped to support instruction of technical and technology related curriculum, usually tied to particular industry, for example, bio-tech, construction, or agriculture.
hasBuildingCareer-TechnicalEducationSpac.Name: hasBuildingCareer-TechnicalEducationSpaceType

hasBuildingCirculationSpaceType.Description: A space designed to enable people to move within the building.
hasBuildingCirculationSpaceType.Name: hasBuildingCirculationSpaceType

hasBuildingFoodServiceSpaceType.Description: The space located, designed, furnished and equipped to support meal programs.
hasBuildingFoodServiceSpaceType.Name: hasBuildingFoodServiceSpaceType

hasBuildingFullServiceKitchenType.Description: The type of kitchen housed in the facility as defined by whether it prepares food to be served onsite and/or at additional locations.
hasBuildingFullServiceKitchenType.Name: hasBuildingFullServiceKitchenType

hasBuildingIndoorAthleticOrPhysicalEduca.Description: The indoor space designed, located, furnished, and equipped for instruction and support of a physical education curriculum and athletic program.
hasBuildingIndoorAthleticOrPhysicalEduca.Name: hasBuildingIndoorAthleticOrPhysicalEducationSpaceType

hasBuildingLibraryOrMediaCenterSpecialty.Description: The primary and auxiliary space designed to provide and support student and staff access to books, periodicals, software, videos, and the Internet.
hasBuildingLibraryOrMediaCenterSpecialty.Name: hasBuildingLibraryOrMediaCenterSpecialtySpaceType

hasBuildingOperationsOrMaintenanceSpaceT.Description: The area designed primarily for conducting activities concerned with maintaining the grounds, buildings, and equipment.
hasBuildingOperationsOrMaintenanceSpaceT.Name: hasBuildingOperationsOrMaintenanceSpaceType

hasBuildingOutdoorAthleticOrPhysicalEduc.Description: The outdoor space designed, located, furnished, and equipped for instruction and support of a physical education curriculum and athletic program.
hasBuildingOutdoorAthleticOrPhysicalEduc.Name: hasBuildingOutdoorAthleticOrPhysicalEducationSpaceType

hasBuildingOutdoorOrNon-athleticSpaceTyp.Description: The outdoor space located, designed, furnished, and equipped primarily for recreation, play and outdoor environmental education.
hasBuildingOutdoorOrNon-athleticSpaceTyp.Name: hasBuildingOutdoorOrNon-athleticSpaceType

hasBuildingPerformingArtsSpecialtySpaceT.Description: The space designed, located, furnished, and equipped for instruction and support of music and drama curricula and productions.
hasBuildingPerformingArtsSpecialtySpaceT.Name: hasBuildingPerformingArtsSpecialtySpaceType

hasBuildingScienceSpecialtySpaceType.Description: The space designed, located, furnished, and equipped for instruction and experimentation in science.
hasBuildingScienceSpecialtySpaceType.Name: hasBuildingScienceSpecialtySpaceType

hasBuildingSpaceDesignType.Description: The primary design or purpose of a space, as determined by its physical layout and built-in systems and equipment, regardless of its current use.
hasBuildingSpaceDesignType.Name: hasBuildingSpaceDesignType

hasBuildingSpaceUtilization.Description: References information about the capacity and assigned utilization of an area within a building including if the area is unassigned.
hasBuildingSpaceUtilization.Name: hasBuildingSpaceUtilization

hasBuildingSpecialEducationSpecialtySpac.Description: The space designed, located, furnished, and equipped to support instruction of children with special physical, emotional, and/or educational needs.
hasBuildingSpecialEducationSpecialtySpac.Name: hasBuildingSpecialEducationSpecialtySpaceType

hasBuildingStudentSupportSpaceType.Description: The space designed to provide student support services such as administrative, technical (e.g., guidance and health), and logistical support to facilitate and enhance instruction.
hasBuildingStudentSupportSpaceType.Name: hasBuildingStudentSupportSpaceType

hasFacilitySpaceUseType.Description: The primary use of a space, as determined by its physical layout and built-in systems and equipment, regardless of its original design.
hasFacilitySpaceUseType.Name: hasFacilitySpaceUseType

BuildingSpaceUtilization.Description: Information about the capacity and assigned utilization of an area within a building including if the area is unassigned.
BuildingSpaceUtilization.Name: BuildingSpaceUtilization

BuildingSpaceUtilizationArea.Description: The area in square feet measured between the principal wall that faces at or near floor level, including alcove spaces, and the outer limits of space designed to serve the activity. Structural space is excluded.
BuildingSpaceUtilizationArea.Name: BuildingSpaceUtilizationArea

hasAvailableUtilizedInstructionalSpace.Description: An indication that the instruction space in a school is used in the calculation of student capacity.
hasAvailableUtilizedInstructionalSpace.Name: hasAvailableUtilizedInstructionalSpace

hasBuildingCapacityFactorIndicator.Description: A designation as to whether the space is included in the calculation of school building capacity under state or local guidelines.
hasBuildingCapacityFactorIndicator.Name: hasBuildingCapacityFactorIndicator

hasBuildingCommunityUseSpaceType.Description: The space designed primarily for community or shared use.
hasBuildingCommunityUseSpaceType.Name: hasBuildingCommunityUseSpaceType

hasBuildingInstructionalSpaceFactorType.Description: A designation as to whether the space is considered an instructional space under state or local guidelines.
hasBuildingInstructionalSpaceFactorType.Name: hasBuildingInstructionalSpaceFactorType

hasBuildingUnassignedSpaceIndicator.Description: An indication that the space in a school, including circulation, administration offices, support spaces, and common areas, is not part of the calculation for capacity.
hasBuildingUnassignedSpaceIndicator.Name: hasBuildingUnassignedSpaceIndicator

BuildingSystemCategory.Description: Type of building within a school such as a playground, gym, or classroom.
BuildingSystemCategory.Name: BuildingSystemCategory

hasBuildingAirDistributionSystemType.Description: The primary means by which air is circulated, freshened, and exhausted.
hasBuildingAirDistributionSystemType.Name: hasBuildingAirDistributionSystemType

hasBuildingCommunicationsManagementCompo.Description: The type of system, interface, and management components for carrying voice, video, and data throughout a building.
hasBuildingCommunicationsManagementCompo.Name: hasBuildingCommunicationsManagementComponentSystemType

hasBuildingCoolingGenerationSystemType.Description: The type of mechanical systems and building designs used for cooling.
hasBuildingCoolingGenerationSystemType.Name: hasBuildingCoolingGenerationSystemType

hasBuildingElectricalSystemType.Description: The components and system required to distribute electricity throughout the building or site.
hasBuildingElectricalSystemType.Name: hasBuildingElectricalSystemType

hasBuildingFireProtectionSystemType.Description: The type of system that protects the facility against fire.
hasBuildingFireProtectionSystemType.Name: hasBuildingFireProtectionSystemType

hasBuildingHVACSystemType.Description: The building service system that provides for heating, ventilation and air-conditioning.
hasBuildingHVACSystemType.Name: hasBuildingHVACSystemType

hasBuildingHeatingGenerationSystemType.Description: The method by which the heat is distributed and delivered throughout the room(s) or building.
hasBuildingHeatingGenerationSystemType.Name: hasBuildingHeatingGenerationSystemType

hasBuildingMechanicalConveyingSystemType.Description: Mechanical means for moving people and equipment within buildings.
hasBuildingMechanicalConveyingSystemType.Name: hasBuildingMechanicalConveyingSystemType

hasBuildingMechanicalSystemType.Description: The major manufactured systems required to operate a building.
hasBuildingMechanicalSystemType.Name: hasBuildingMechanicalSystemType

hasBuildingPlumbingSystemType.Description: The component of an on-site system for supplying, eliminating, and treating water.
hasBuildingPlumbingSystemType.Name: hasBuildingPlumbingSystemType

hasBuildingSecuritySystemType.Description: The type of system that protects the facility from intrusion.
hasBuildingSecuritySystemType.Name: hasBuildingSecuritySystemType

hasBuildingSystemType.Description: The type of system that is installed in the building or site.
hasBuildingSystemType.Name: hasBuildingSystemType

hasBuildingTechnologyWiringSystemType.Description: The means through which voice, video, audio, and data information are conveyed.
hasBuildingTechnologyWiringSystemType.Name: hasBuildingTechnologyWiringSystemType

hasBuildingVerticalTransportationSystemT.Description: The type of system used to convey persons or freight between floors.
hasBuildingVerticalTransportationSystemT.Name: hasBuildingVerticalTransportationSystemType

BuildingSystemComponent.Description: Information about a component of a system within a facility including the installation date, lifecycle cost, description, and useful life.
BuildingSystemComponent.Name: BuildingSystemComponent

BuildingInstitutionalEquipmentDescriptio.Description: Equipment that is installed for use in support of instructional program such as kilns for art, planetarium equipment for astronomy, fitness equipment for physical education.
BuildingInstitutionalEquipmentDescriptio.Name: BuildingInstitutionalEquipmentDescription

ComponentOrFixtureUsefulLife.Description: The anticipated time (in years) from the time of installation or service that a properly maintained system, component, equipment, or fixture is expected to operate effectively and efficiently.
ComponentOrFixtureUsefulLife.Name: ComponentOrFixtureUsefulLife

FacilityComponentIdentificationCode.Description: A unique number or alphanumeric code assigned to a component by a school, school system, state, or other agency or entity.
FacilityComponentIdentificationCode.Name: FacilityComponentIdentificationCode

InstallationDate.Description: The year in which the system, component, equipment, or fixture was originally installed.
InstallationDate.Name: InstallationDate

Life-cycleCost.Description: The total cost of acquiring, owning, operating, and disposing of a building, facility, or piece of equipment over its useful life.
Life-cycleCost.Name: Life-cycleCost

hasBuildingSystemCategory.Description: References type of building within a school such as a playground, gym, or classroom.
hasBuildingSystemCategory.Name: hasBuildingSystemCategory

hasBuildingSystemComponentService.Description: References information that tracks the service record of a building system component.
hasBuildingSystemComponentService.Name: hasBuildingSystemComponentService

hasFacilityCompliance.Description: References designation that assesses whether a facility or building meets safety and teaching standards set by the school district, state, and federal agencies.
hasFacilityCompliance.Name: hasFacilityCompliance

hasFacilityFurnishingsType.Description: Moveable assets that are provided so the building or interior assets can be utilized by occupants for their intended purposes.
hasFacilityFurnishingsType.Name: hasFacilityFurnishingsType

hasFacilitySystemOrComponentCondition.Description: The rating of the system or component functions under the demands of its regular operation.
hasFacilitySystemOrComponentCondition.Name: hasFacilitySystemOrComponentCondition

BuildingSystemComponentService.Description: Information that tracks the service record of a building system component.
BuildingSystemComponentService.Name: BuildingSystemComponentService

ComponentOrFixtureScheduledServicedDate.Description: The month, day, and year a major component, system, equipment, or fixture is scheduled to be serviced for preventive or routine maintenance.
ComponentOrFixtureScheduledServicedDate.Name: ComponentOrFixtureScheduledServicedDate

ComponentOrFixtureServicedDate.Description: The month, day, and year a system, component, equipment, or fixture was serviced for repair or routine maintenance.
ComponentOrFixtureServicedDate.Name: ComponentOrFixtureServicedDate

CEDSBaseResource.Description: The CEDS Base Resource class represents the base resource in the Common Education Data Standards (CEDS) ontology. It serves as the foundational class from which all other CEDS resource classes inherit common properties and attributes. Subclasses of CEDSBaseResource may include specific types of instructional resources, such as students, staff, courses, assessments, etc.
CEDSBaseResource.Name: CEDSBaseResource

RecordEndDateTime.Description: The end date and, optionally, time that a record is active as used to support version control.
RecordEndDateTime.Name: RecordEndDateTime

RecordReferenceIdentifier.Description: A unique number or alphanumeric code assigned to a record.
RecordReferenceIdentifier.Name: RecordReferenceIdentifier

RecordStartDateTime.Description: The start date and, optionally, time that a record is active as used to support version control.
RecordStartDateTime.Name: RecordStartDateTime

hasDataCollection.Description: References data collections track the details of data submissions as part of an organized, time-bound collection event, typically governed by specific deadlines and requirements, to ensure accurate and timely data reporting in a structured system.
hasDataCollection.Name: hasDataCollection

hasRecordReferenceIdentificationSystem.Description: A coding scheme that is used for identification and record-keeping purposes to refer to a record.
hasRecordReferenceIdentificationSystem.Name: hasRecordReferenceIdentificationSystem

hasRecordStatus.Description: References a classification representing the current condition, lifecycle stage, or operational state of a data record, including associated key dates, committing organization, committing individual, and statuses.
hasRecordStatus.Name: hasRecordStatus

Campus.Description: A location where the postsecondary institution provides services (admin, residential, education). May be virtual or physical. May be called by other terms (e.g., branch, location site regional campus).
Campus.Name: Campus

CareerAndTechnicalCourse.Description: The organization of subject matter and related learning experiences provided for the instruction of students on a regular or systematic basis, usually for a predetermined period of time (e.g., a semester or two-week workshop) to an individual or group of students (e.g., a class).
CareerAndTechnicalCourse.Name: CareerAndTechnicalCourse

AvailableCarnegieUnitCredit.Description: Measured in Carnegie units, the amount of credit available to a student who successfully meets the objectives of the course. A course meeting every day for one period of the school day over the span of a school year offers one Carnegie unit. A Carnegie unit is thus a measure of "seat time" rather than a measure of attainment of the course objectives.
AvailableCarnegieUnitCredit.Name: AvailableCarnegieUnitCredit

hasAdditionalCreditType.Description: The type of credits or units of value available for the completion of a course in addition to Carnegie Units.
hasAdditionalCreditType.Name: hasAdditionalCreditType

hasCIPCode.Description: A six-digit code in the form xx.xxxx that identifies instructional program specialties within educational institutions.
hasCIPCode.Name: hasCIPCode

hasCIPVersion.Description: The version of CIP being reported.
hasCIPVersion.Name: hasCIPVersion

hasCareerCluster.Description: The career cluster that defines the industry or occupational focus which may be associated with a career pathways program, plan of study, or course.
hasCareerCluster.Name: hasCareerCluster

hasCoreAcademicCourse.Description: The course meets the state definition of a core academic course.
hasCoreAcademicCourse.Name: hasCoreAcademicCourse

hasCourseAlignedWithStandards.Description: An indication whether a course is aligned with the established standards of a curriculum framework.
hasCourseAlignedWithStandards.Name: hasCourseAlignedWithStandards

hasCreditUnitType.Description: The type of credits or units of value awarded for the completion of a course.
hasCreditUnitType.Name: hasCreditUnitType

hasCurriculumFrameworkType.Description: An indication of the standard curriculum used for this course.
hasCurriculumFrameworkType.Name: hasCurriculumFrameworkType

hasHighSchoolCourseRequirement.Description: An indication that this course credit is required for a high school diploma.
hasHighSchoolCourseRequirement.Name: hasHighSchoolCourseRequirement

hasSCEDCourseCode.Description: The five-digit SCED code. The first two-digits of the code represent the Course Subject Area and the next three digits identify the course number. These identifiers are fairly general but provide enough specificity to identify the course's topic and to distinguish it from other courses in that subject area.
hasSCEDCourseCode.Name: hasSCEDCourseCode

hasSCEDCourseSubjectArea.Description: The intended major subject area of the education course.
hasSCEDCourseSubjectArea.Name: hasSCEDCourseSubjectArea

CareerAndTechnicalStudentAcademicRecord.Description: Summary academic record information for a career and technical education student.
CareerAndTechnicalStudentAcademicRecord.Name: CareerAndTechnicalStudentAcademicRecord

CreditsAttemptedCumulative.Description: The cumulative number of credits a person attempts to earn by taking courses during their enrollment in their current education institution as well as those credits transferred from an education institution in which the person had been previously enrolled.
CreditsAttemptedCumulative.Name: CreditsAttemptedCumulative

CreditsEarnedCumulative.Description: The cumulative number of credits a person earns by completing courses or examinations during their enrollment in the current education institution as well as those credits transferred from an education institution in which the person had been previously enrolled.
CreditsEarnedCumulative.Name: CreditsEarnedCumulative

DiplomaOrCredentialAwardDate.Description: The month and year on which the diploma/credential is awarded to a student in recognition of his/her completion of the curricular requirements.
DiplomaOrCredentialAwardDate.Name: DiplomaOrCredentialAwardDate

NumberOfCreditsEarned.Description: The number of credits an individual earns by the successful completion of a course.
NumberOfCreditsEarned.Name: NumberOfCreditsEarned

hasHighSchoolDiplomaType.Description: The type of diploma/credential that is awarded to a person in recognition of his/her completion of the curricular requirements.
hasHighSchoolDiplomaType.Name: hasHighSchoolDiplomaType

hasProfessionalOrTechnicalCredentialConf.Description: An indicator of the category of credential conferred by a state occupational licensing entity or industry organization for competency in a specific area measured by a set of pre-established standards.
hasProfessionalOrTechnicalCredentialConf.Name: hasProfessionalOrTechnicalCredentialConferred

CharterSchoolAuthorizingOrganization.Description: An organization responsible for authorizing charter schools.
CharterSchoolAuthorizingOrganization.Name: CharterSchoolAuthorizingOrganization

CharterSchoolManagementOrganization.Description: A separate legal entity that 1) contracts with one or more charter schools to manage, operate, and oversee the charter schools; or 2) holds a charter, or charters, to operate multiple charter schools. (see Charter School Management Organization Type)
CharterSchoolManagementOrganization.Name: CharterSchoolManagementOrganization

hasCharterSchoolManagementOrganizationTy.Description: The type of organization that is a separate legal entity that 1) contracts with one or more charter schools to manage, operate, and oversee the charter schools; or 2) holds a charter, or charters, to operate multiple charter schools.
hasCharterSchoolManagementOrganizationTy.Name: hasCharterSchoolManagementOrganizationType

hasOrganization.Description: References an organized group of one or more people with particular purpose.
hasOrganization.Name: hasOrganization

Classroom.Description: A room where educational services are provided by a school, school system, state, or other agency or entity.
Classroom.Name: Classroom

ClassroomIdentifier.Description: A unique number or alphanumeric code assigned to a room by a school, school system, state, or other agency or entity.
ClassroomIdentifier.Name: ClassroomIdentifier

hasLocation.Description: References a location such as a physical address or mailing address.
hasLocation.Name: hasLocation

CompetencyDefinition.Description: A resource that states a capability or behavior that a person may learn or be able to do within a given context with references to potential levels of competence, a mastery threshold, and other contextualizing metadata.
CompetencyDefinition.Name: CompetencyDefinition

CompetencyDefinitionCode.Description: A human-referenceable code designated by the publisher to identify the item in the hierarchy of competency definitions.
CompetencyDefinitionCode.Name: CompetencyDefinitionCode

CompetencyDefinitionConceptKeyword.Description: The significant topicality of the competency definition using free-text keywords and phrases.
CompetencyDefinitionConceptKeyword.Name: CompetencyDefinitionConceptKeyword

CompetencyDefinitionConceptTerm.Description: The topicality of the competency definition, e.g. "Pythagorean Theorem," "Trigonometric functions," "Forces and energy," "Scientific method," "Oral history," etc.
CompetencyDefinitionConceptTerm.Name: CompetencyDefinitionConceptTerm

CompetencyDefinitionIdentifier.Description: The globally unique identifier (GUID) issued by the publisher of the competency framework that uniquely identifies the definition in the hierarchy of competency definitions using a RFC 4122 compliant 32-character hexadecimal string, such as 21EC2020-3AEA-1069-A2DD-08002B30309D.
CompetencyDefinitionIdentifier.Name: CompetencyDefinitionIdentifier

CompetencyDefinitionLicense.Description: The full text or URL reference to a legal document giving official permission to do something with the competency definition statement.
CompetencyDefinitionLicense.Name: CompetencyDefinitionLicense

CompetencyDefinitionNotes.Description: Information about the derivation of a Competency Definition Statement.
CompetencyDefinitionNotes.Name: CompetencyDefinitionNotes

CompetencyDefinitionParentCode.Description: A human-referenceable code designated by the publisher to identify the parent item in the hierarchy of competency definitions.
CompetencyDefinitionParentCode.Name: CompetencyDefinitionParentCode

CompetencyDefinitionParentIdentifier.Description: The globally unique identifier (GUID) issued by the publisher of the competency framework that uniquely identifies the parent item in the hierarchy of competency definitions using a RFC 4122 compliant 32-character hexadecimal string, such as 21EC2020-3AEA-1069-A2DD-08002B30309D.
CompetencyDefinitionParentIdentifier.Name: CompetencyDefinitionParentIdentifier

CompetencyDefinitionParentURL.Description: A network-resolvable Uniform Resource Locator (URL) pointing to the authoritative reference for the hierarchal parent of the competency definition.
CompetencyDefinitionParentURL.Name: CompetencyDefinitionParentURL

CompetencyDefinitionPreviousVersionIdent.Description: The unique identifier of the previous version of the Competency Definition if the statement was modified.
CompetencyDefinitionPreviousVersionIdent.Name: CompetencyDefinitionPreviousVersionIdentifier

CompetencyDefinitionSequence.Description: A set of one or more alphanumeric characters and/or symbols denoting the positioning of the statement being described in a sequential listing of statements.
CompetencyDefinitionSequence.Name: CompetencyDefinitionSequence

CompetencyDefinitionShortName.Description: The short name or label for the competency definition or its node in a competency framework.
CompetencyDefinitionShortName.Name: CompetencyDefinitionShortName

CompetencyDefinitionStatement.Description: The text of the statement. The textual content that either describes a specific competency or describes a less granular group of competencies within the taxonomy of the competency framework.
CompetencyDefinitionStatement.Name: CompetencyDefinitionStatement

CompetencyDefinitionTextComplexityMaximu.Description: The maximum value in the range of text complexity applicable to a language competency definition using the scaling system defined by Text Complexity System, e.g. Lexile(tm).
CompetencyDefinitionTextComplexityMaximu.Name: CompetencyDefinitionTextComplexityMaximumValue

CompetencyDefinitionTextComplexityMinimu.Description: The minimum value in the range of text complexity applicable to a language competency definition using the scaling system defined by Text Complexity System, e.g. Lexile(tm).
CompetencyDefinitionTextComplexityMinimu.Name: CompetencyDefinitionTextComplexityMinimumValue

Incident.Description: The details for an incident involving a student or school.
Incident.Name: Incident

IncidentCost.Description: The value of any quantifiable monetary loss directly resulting from the incident. Examples include the value of repairs necessitated by vandalism of a school facility, the value of personnel resources used for repairs or consumed by the incident, the value of stolen items, and the value of time consumed by an incident (e.g., instructional time involved in evacuating a school during a false fire alarm).  Cost may be reported by specific monetary amount or range.
IncidentCost.Name: IncidentCost

IncidentDate.Description: The year, month and day on which the incident occurred.
IncidentDate.Name: IncidentDate

IncidentIdentifier.Description: A locally assigned unique identifier (within the school or school district) to identify each specific incident or occurrence. The same identifier should be used to document the entire incident even if it included multiple offenses and multiple offenders.
IncidentIdentifier.Name: IncidentIdentifier

IncidentRegulationViolatedDescription.Description: A description of the rule, regulation, or standard that was violated when an incident occurred (e.g., the identification of a relevant law, conduct standard, or acceptable use policy).
IncidentRegulationViolatedDescription.Name: IncidentRegulationViolatedDescription

IncidentTime.Description: An indication of the time of day the incident took place.
IncidentTime.Name: IncidentTime

ReporterIdentifier.Description: Identifies the reporter of the incident using  a pre-existing unique student identifier or unique staff identifier, when the reporter is a student or staff member.
ReporterIdentifier.Name: ReporterIdentifier

hasHarassmentOrBullyingReligionType.Description: The actual or perceived religious affiliation of a student that is the basis of an allegation of harassment or bullying.
hasHarassmentOrBullyingReligionType.Name: hasHarassmentOrBullyingReligionType

hasIncidentActivity.Description: The activity taking place during the occurrence.
hasIncidentActivity.Name: hasIncidentActivity

hasIncidentBehavior.Description: Categories of behavior coded for use in describing an incident.
hasIncidentBehavior.Name: hasIncidentBehavior

hasIncidentInjuryType.Description: An indication of the occurrence of physical injury to participants involved in the incident and, if so, the level of injury sustained.
hasIncidentInjuryType.Name: hasIncidentInjuryType

hasIncidentLocation.Description: Identifies where the incident occurred and whether or not it occurred on campus.
hasIncidentLocation.Name: hasIncidentLocation

hasIncidentMultipleOffenseType.Description: An indication of whether the offense was primary or secondary in nature when a single incident included more than one type of offense.
hasIncidentMultipleOffenseType.Name: hasIncidentMultipleOffenseType

hasIncidentPerpetratorInjuryType.Description: An indication of the occurrence of physical injury to the perpetrator(s) (participants) involved in the incident and, if so, the level of injury sustained.
hasIncidentPerpetratorInjuryType.Name: hasIncidentPerpetratorInjuryType

hasIncidentPerson.Description: References the relationship between a person and an Incident involving a student or school.
hasIncidentPerson.Name: hasIncidentPerson

hasIncidentRelatedToDisabilityManifestat.Description: An indication whether a student's behavior (offense) was a manifestation of, or related to, a disability condition.
hasIncidentRelatedToDisabilityManifestat.Name: hasIncidentRelatedToDisabilityManifestation

hasIncidentReportedToLawEnforcementIndic.Description: An indication that the school resource officer or any other law enforcement official was notified about the incident, regardless of whether official action is taken.
hasIncidentReportedToLawEnforcementIndic.Name: hasIncidentReportedToLawEnforcementIndicator

hasIncidentReporterType.Description: Information on the type of person who reported the incident. When known and/or if useful, use a more specific option code (e.g., "Counselor" rather than "Professional Staff").
hasIncidentReporterType.Name: hasIncidentReporterType

hasIncidentResponsibilityStaffIndicator.Description: An indication of whether a staff member was determined to be involved in an incident as an offender (the person who committed the infraction constituting the incident).
hasIncidentResponsibilityStaffIndicator.Name: hasIncidentResponsibilityStaffIndicator

hasIncidentTimeDescriptionCode.Description: A code for the description of the time of day that an incident took place.
hasIncidentTimeDescriptionCode.Name: hasIncidentTimeDescriptionCode

hasSecondaryIncidentBehavior.Description: Supplemental information about an incident when the primary offense is more serious in nature than alcohol or drug, etc. offenses.
hasSecondaryIncidentBehavior.Name: hasSecondaryIncidentBehavior

hasShootingIncidentIndicator.Description: An indication of whether the incident involved a shooting, regardless of whether anyone was hurt or whether a student or non-student used a firearm or explosive device.
hasShootingIncidentIndicator.Name: hasShootingIncidentIndicator

hasWeaponType.Description: Identifies the type of weapon used during an incident.
hasWeaponType.Name: hasWeaponType

IncidentPerson.Description: The relationship between a person and an Incident involving a student or school.
IncidentPerson.Name: IncidentPerson

IncidentPerpetratorIdentifier.Description: Identifies the perpetrator of the incident by use of a pre-existing unique identifier assigned to a student or staff member by a school or district.
IncidentPerpetratorIdentifier.Name: IncidentPerpetratorIdentifier

IncidentVictimIdentifier.Description: Identifies the victim of the incident by use of a pre-existing unique identifier assigned to a student or staff member by a school or district.
IncidentVictimIdentifier.Name: IncidentVictimIdentifier

Using this data element permits linkage to descriptive information about the individual in the student or staff database.
IncidentWitnessIdentifier.Name: IncidentWitnessIdentifier

hasIncidentPerpetratorType.Description: Information on the type of individual who committed an incident. A "perpetrator" is an individual involved in an incident as an offender (the person who committed the infraction constituting the incident).
hasIncidentPerpetratorType.Name: hasIncidentPerpetratorType

hasIncidentPersonRoleType.Description: The role or type of participation of a person in a discipline incident.
hasIncidentPersonRoleType.Name: hasIncidentPersonRoleType

hasIncidentVictimType.Description: Information on the type of individual who was injured or otherwise harmed as a direct result of the incident. A "victim" is the individual who suffers injury or harm that directly results from the incident.
hasIncidentVictimType.Name: hasIncidentVictimType

hasIncidentWitnessType.Description: Information on the type of individual who witnessed the incident and can give a firsthand account of an incident that was seen, heard, or experienced.
hasIncidentWitnessType.Name: hasIncidentWitnessType

Homeless children and youth include: 1) children and youth who are sharing the housing of other persons due to loss of housing, economic hardship, or a similar reason; are living in motels, hotels, trailer parks, or camping grounds due to the lack of alternative adequate accommodations; are living in emergency or transitional shelters; are abandoned in hospitals; or are awaiting foster care placement; 2) children and youth who have a primary nighttime residence that is a public or private place not designed for or originally used as a regular sleeping accommodation for human beings; or 3) children and youths who are living in cars, parks, public spaces, abandoned buildings, substandard housing, bus or train stations, or similar settings. 4) migratory children who qualify as homeless because the children are living in circumstances described in the above. hasEnglishLearnerStatus.Description: In coordination with the state's definition based on Section 8101(20) of the ESEA, as amended by the ESSA, the term 'English learner', when used with respect to an individual, means an individual: (A) who is aged 3 through 21; (B) who is enrolled or preparing to enroll in an elementary school or a secondary school; (C) (i) who was not born in the United States or whose native languages are languages other than English; (ii) (I) who is a Native American or Alaska Native, or a native resident of the outlying areas; and (II) who comes from an environment where a language other than English has had a significant impact on the individual's level of English language proficiency; or (iii) who is migratory, whose native language is a language other than English, and who come from an environment where a language other than English is dominant; and (D) whose difficulties in speaking, reading, writing, or understanding the English language may be sufficient to deny the individual (i) the ability to meet the challenging State academic standards; (ii) the ability to successfully achieve in classrooms where the language of instruction is English; or (iii) the opportunity to participate fully in society.
hasEnglishLearnerStatus.Name: hasEnglishLearnerStatus

hasHomelessUnaccompaniedYouthStatus.Description: A homeless unaccompanied youth is a youth who is not in the physical custody of a parent or guardian and who fits the McKinney-Vento definition of homeless. Students must be both unaccompanied and homeless to be included as unaccompanied homeless youth. There is no age range specified for an unaccompanied youth in the law. The upper age range is determined by what a state defines as school age, unless the child is in special education. The upper age range for students in special education may extend to 22 years of age. There is no lower age range. Therefore, as an example, a young child not in the physical custody of a parent or guardian, though living with a caregiver, and is living in a situation that is not fixed, regular, and adequate, would be identified as a homeless unaccompanied youth.
hasHomelessUnaccompaniedYouthStatus.Name: hasHomelessUnaccompaniedYouthStatus

hasIDEAIndicator.Description: A person having intellectual disability; hearing impairment, including deafness; speech or language impairment; visual impairment, including blindness; serious emotional disturbance (hereafter referred to as emotional disturbance); orthopedic impairment; autism; traumatic brain injury; developmental delay; other health impairment; specific learning disability; deaf-blindness; or multiple disabilities and who, by reason thereof, receive special education and related services under the Individuals with Disabilities Education Act (IDEA) according to an Individualized Education Program (IEP), Individual Family Service Plan (IFSP), or service plan.
hasIDEAIndicator.Name: hasIDEAIndicator

hasLowIncomeStatus.Description: A person who receives or is a member of a family who receives a total family income in the 6 months prior to enrollment of 70 percent of the income standard for a family of that size or that does not exceed the poverty line, or the person is receiving or is a member of a family who is receiving cash assistance payments from Federal, State, or local agencies or food stamps, or the person can be designated as homeless under the McKinney Act.

hasMigrantStatus.Description: Persons who are, or whose parents or spouses are, migratory agricultural workers, including migratory dairy workers, or migratory fishers, and who, in the preceding 36 months, in order to obtain, or accompany such parents or spouses, in order to obtain, temporary or seasonal employment in agricultural or fishing work (A) have moved from one LEA to another; (B) in a state that comprises a single LEA, have moved from one administrative area to another within such LEA; or (C) reside in an LEA of more than 15,000 square miles, and migrate a distance of 20 miles or more to a temporary residence to engage in a fishing activity.
hasMigrantStatus.Name: hasMigrantStatus

hasPerkinsEnglishLearnerStatus.Description: A secondary student, an adult, or an out-of-school youth, who has limited ability in speaking, reading, writing, or understanding English language, and (a) whose native language is a language other than English, or (b) who lives in a family or community environment in which a language other than English is the dominant language.

hasCIPCode.Description: A six-digit code in the form xx.xxxx that identifies instructional program specialties within educational institutions.

hasFacultyStatus.Description: Persons identified by the institution as such and typically those whose initial assignments are made for the purpose of conducting instruction, research or public service as a principal activity (or activities). They may hold academic rank titles of professor, associate professor, assistant professor, instructor, lecturer or the equivalent of any of those academic ranks. Faculty may also include the chancellor/president, provost, vice provosts, deans, directors or the equivalent, as well as associate deans, assistant deans and executive officers of academic departments (chairpersons, heads or the equivalent) if their principal activity is instruction combined with research and/or public service. The designation as "faculty" is separate from the activities to which they may be currently assigned. For example, a newly appointed president of an institution may also be appointed as a faculty member. Graduate, instruction, and research assistants are not included in this category.

hasFullTimeStatus.Description: An indication of whether an individual is employed for a standard number of hours (as determined by civil or organizational policies) in a week, month, or other period of time.

hasGraduateAssistantIPEDSOccupationCateg.Description: The Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS) occupational categories used to report graduate assistants.

hasGraduateAssistantStatus.Description: Graduate-level students employed on a part-time basis, not limited to, but often employed for the primary purpose of assisting in classroom or laboratory instruction or in the conduct of research. hasGraduateAssistantStatus.Name: hasGraduateAssistantStatus

hasIPEDSOccupationalCategory.Description: The Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS) occupational categories used to report employees.
hasIPEDSOccupationalCategory.Name: hasIPEDSOccupationalCategory

hasInstructionalStaffStatus.Description: Staff whose primary function/occupational activity is primarily instruction or instruction combined with research and/or public service. Does not include medical school staff.
hasInstructionalStaffStatus.Name: hasInstructionalStaffStatus

hasMedicalSchoolStaffStatus.Description: Staff employed by or employees working in the medical school component of a postsecondary institution or in a free standing medical school. PostsecondaryStudentAcademicAward.Description: An award conferred by a college, university, or other postsecondary education institution as official recognition for the successful completion of a program of study.

hasAcademicAwardLevelConferred.Description: An indicator of the category of award conferred by a college, university, or other postsecondary education institution as official recognition for the successful completion of a program of study.

hasPESCAwardLevelType.Description: An indicator of the category of award conferred by a college, university, or other postsecondary education institution as official recognition for the successful completion of a program of study.

DiplomaOrCredentialAwardDate.Description: The month and year on which the diploma/credential is awarded to a student in recognition of his/her completion of the curricular requirements.

This is obtained by dividing the total grade points received by the total number of credits attempted. This usually includes grade points received and credits attempted in his or her current school as well as those transferred from schools in which the person was previously enrolled.

NumberOfCreditsEarned.Name: NumberOfCreditsEarned

PostsecondaryStudentEnteringTerm.Description: The term and year of the initial enrollment of an individual in credit bearing courses or developmental/remedial courses at an institution after completing high school or a high school equivalency program (e.g., GED, Adult High School Diploma).

hasAcademicTermDesignator.Description: The academic term for which the data apply.

hasCreditHoursAppliedOtherProgram.Description: Codes identifying the set of credit hours taken in other programs or degrees that were applied to the individual's degree.

This is obtained by dividing the total grade points received by the total number of credits attempted. This usually includes grade points received and credits attempted in his or her current school as well as those transferred from schools in which the person was previously enrolled.
GPACumulative.Name: GPACumulative

HighSchoolPercentile.Description: The High School Rank divided by the Size of High School Graduating Class expressed as a percentage.

TotalNumberInClass.Description: The total number of students in the student's high school graduating class.

hasGPAWeightedIndicator.Description: An indication of whether the reported Grade Point Average is weighted or unweighted.

hasGradePointAverageDomain.Description: The domain to which the Grade Point Average is referencing.
hasGradePointAverageDomain.Name: hasGradePointAverageDomain

hasPostsecondaryApplicant.Description: An individual who has fulfilled the institution's requirements to be considered for admission (including payment or waiving of the application fee, if any) and who has been notified of one of the following actions: admission, nonadmission, placement on waiting list, or application withdrawn (by applicant or institution). Include early decision, early action, and students who began studies during summer in this cohort.
hasPostsecondaryApplicant.Name: hasPostsecondaryApplicant

hasWaitListedStudent.Description: A person who meets the admission requirements but will only be offered a place in the class if space becomes available.
hasWaitListedStudent.Name: hasWaitListedStudent

PostsecondaryStudentCohort.Description: Information about a cohort of postsecndary students.

CohortGraduationYear.Description: The year the cohort is expected to graduate.

At the time of the parent's or guardian's death, the student must be less than 24 years of age or enrolled in college or career school at least part-time.
hasChildrenOfFallenHeroesIndicator.Name: hasChildrenOfFallenHeroesIndicator

hasCohortExclusion.Description: Those persons who may be removed (deleted) from a cohort (or subcohort). For the Graduation Rates and Fall Enrollment retention rate reporting, persons may be removed from a cohort if they left the institution for one of the following reasons: death or total and permanent disability; service in the armed forces (including those called to active duty); service with a foreign aid service of the federal government, such as the Peace Corps; or service on official church missions.

hasDependencyStatus.Description: A person's classification as dependent or independent with regards to eligibility for Title IV Federal Student aid.

hasFirstGenerationCollegeStudent.Description: The term First Generation College Student means an individual both of whose parents did not complete a baccalaureate degree or in the case of any individual who regularly resided with and received support from only one parent, an individual whose only such parent did not complete a baccalaureate degree.

hasMaternalGuardianEducation.Description: The highest level of education attained by a person's mother or maternal guardian

hasEmployedAfterExit.Name: hasEmployedAfterExit

hasEmployedWhileEnrolled.Description: An individual who is a paid employee or works in his or her own business, profession, or farm, as reported through the State Unemployment Insurance Wage Report, FEDES, or WRIS, and at the same time is enrolled in secondary, postsecondary, or adult education or workforce programs.

Technologies used for instruction may include: Internet; one-way and two-way transmissions through open broadcasts, closed circuit, cable, microwave, broadband lines, fiber optics, satellite or wireless communication devices; audio conferencing; and video cassette, DVDs, and CD-ROMs, if the cassette, DVDs, and CD-ROMs are used in a course in conjunction with the technologies listed above.

hasDistanceEducationProgramEnrollmentInd.Description: An individual's enrollment in a program for which all the required coursework for program completion is able to be completed via distance education courses. It also includes persons enrolled in the fall term who attended college for the first time in the prior summer term, and persons who entered with advanced standing (college credits earned before graduation from high school).
